title: Jesus' Woes Against the Hypocrites
description: Jesus pronounces a series of woes against the scribes and Pharisees for their hypocrisy: they shut the kingdom of heaven, make converts children of Gehenna, act as blind guides in matters of oaths, tithe while neglecting justice and mercy, clean only the outside of the cup, and build the tombs of the prophets while being themselves descendants of those who murdered them. Finally, he laments over Jerusalem for killing the prophets and predicts that their house will be left desolate.
